bash {"cmd": "python3 -c "
import pandas as pd

sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')
costs = pd.read_csv('data/costs.csv')

merged = sales.merge(costs, on='product')
merged['profit'] = merged['revenue'] - merged['units'] * merged['unit_cost']

# Q1: total profit by region
region_profit = merged.groupby('region')['profit'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
print('Region profit:')
print(region_profit)
print()

# Q2: lowest profit region
lowest_region = region_profit.idxmin()
print('Lowest region:', lowest_region)

# Within lowest region, product profit
lowest_region_data = merged[merged['region'] == lowest_region]
product_profit = lowest_region_data.groupby('product')['profit'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
print('Product profit in', lowest_region)
print(product_profit)
"
"}
